name: 진흙게
appearance: Wide clay-brown crab with one oversized stone-encrusted pincer, pale blue underside, legs readable as compact pairs.

motions.stand: Facing left, eyestalks turn and blink separately, the oversized stone pincer opens then closes slowly while two small walking feet adjust, return to the planted guard.
motions.move: Facing left, crab scuttles in place with coordinated alternating compact leg pairs, body stays broad and low, large stone pincer held ahead on the left and small claw counterbalances, seamless cycle.
motions.attack1: Facing left, lift and open the oversized stone pincer in a broad wind-up, thrust it left and snap the jaws closed at clear contact, pull the claw back and return to the original low guard. Keep only one oversized pincer.
motions.hit1: Facing left, eyestalks pull down and large claw shields the face, leg pairs buckle briefly under the shell, reopen the guard and recover.
motions.die1: Facing left, claws relax open and eyestalks droop, paired legs fold under the shell and the crab rolls partly onto the pale-blue side, finish grounded and motionless.

args.description: Original fantasy RPG enemy sprite, full creature visible, isolated on transparent background. Full creature occupies about 44-52 pixels in this 64 pixel canvas with transparent safety margins.
